# JobPulse AI Agent

> An AI job-search command centre that lives inside Claude Code: it searches 8 job boards, tailors resumes, writes cover letters, researches companies, and assists with browser-based applications.

JobPulse is a Claude Code plugin for people running a real job search. One slash command runs the whole loop: onboarding, deep search across Indeed / LinkedIn / Glassdoor / ZipRecruiter / Google / Bayt / Naukri / BDJobs, resume review or build, per-role company research, resume customization against each JD, a targeted cover letter, interview prep, and optional browser-assisted apply. All data stays local in a `job-search/` folder in the user's working directory — there is no cloud account, no API key, no telemetry.

## What it does

- Searches 8 job boards in parallel with one call (`search_jobs_batch`), returning deduped, salary-normalised results.
- Reviews an existing resume or builds one from the user's files, with a base-practice and formatting reference library.
- Produces a per-company research brief (values, red/green flags, "Resume Customization Notes").
- Tailors the base resume per job posting — reorder and keyword-match only, never fabricates experience.
- Drafts a 3-paragraph, 200–280-word cover letter grounded in the research brief.
- Generates STAR-outline interview questions and company-specific questions to ask back.
- Optionally fills the application form in the user's browser, one field at a time, never auto-submitting.

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add JCodesMore/jcodesmore-plugins
/plugin install jobs-for-ai-agents@jcodesmore-plugins
```

Restart Claude Code, then run `/findmeajob`.

Requires Claude Code, Python ≥ 3.10, Node.js ≥ 18. No accounts, no API keys. Dependencies install automatically on first run.

## Entry points

- `/findmeajob` — the full workflow (onboarding → search → research → tailoring → packages).
- `/apply` — browser-assisted form fill; always asks before submitting.
- `/setup` — view or edit preferences, reset data, manage resumes.
- `/agent-seo` — ship the AI-agent-detectable SEO bundle for any site or product (llms.txt, agents.json, JSON-LD, robots.txt, sitemap.xml). Runs standalone against any directory.
